annotations.title: Email auth check: SPF, DKIM, DMARC

description: Email authentication check for a domain: the SPF record and its all-policy, DKIM keys at the common selectors, the DMARC record and policy, plus MX, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, with a 0-100 score, a grade and a list of fixes. Public DNS only; no mail is sent. Use to verify a sender domain's SPF, DKIM and DMARC setup, to debug mail landing in spam, or to vet a domain before trusting its mail. Example: domain=github.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

domain.description: The sending domain, such as example.com (or a URL; its host is used)

email.description: Optional address to check as well
